summary: Ultrapar Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing that shareholder Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPPIB) notified it of a 4.94% ownership stake (55,117,773 common shares) as of June 1, 2026. CPPIB stated it does not intend to change control or management. This is a routine disclosure of a passive ownership threshold under CVM Resolution 44/21, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, or activist campaign is involved. The filing serves as an ordinary ownership notification with no actionable deal terms or corporate action for investors.
